title: Investigation Continues After Contractor Found Dead at Webb County Lift Station
excerpt: John Wesley Hammock, 35, a subcontractor doing county work, was found dead Nov. 20 at a lift station between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo. The Sheriff's Office is leading the investigation.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff's Office is investigating the death of a contractor found dead Friday, Nov. 20, at a county lift station between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo.

The Sheriff's Office identified the man Saturday, Nov. 21, as John Wesley Hammock, 35. A county employee found him at the station. County officials confirmed Hammock was working as a subcontractor on county-related work.

The lift station carries signs warning of high voltage and danger. Webb County Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez said the station remains operational after the fire chief's initial assessment. “There was no immediate danger as far as any electrical measures or any gas leaks or anything like that. Nothing like that was discovered,” Gonzalez said.

The Medical Examiner's Office had said it did not expect to provide an update until Wednesday. As of the latest public update, no cause of death has been released, and the investigation remains ongoing.

This is a developing story. Webb Watch 956 will update this report as more information is confirmed.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office; Webb County.
